description: Source file implementing JSON-RPC interface for TextToSpeech plugin, including registration of methods, access control, configuration, and speech control functions.

classes.name: TextToSpeech
classes.description: Class implementing JSON-RPC methods for TextToSpeech plugin, managing configuration, speech control, and access control.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC methods for the plugin.

methods.name: AddToAccessList
methods.description: Adds or updates an entry in the access control list.

methods.name: HasAccess
methods.description: Checks if an app has access to a specific method.

methods.name: SetACL
methods.description: Sets access control list entries based on provided JSON.

methods.name: ListVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets TTS configuration based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for provided text.

methods.name: IsSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if speech is currently in progress.
